formulas.formula: One paycheck, a whole family: plan every dollar, track every kid, and build a safety net.
1. Setup: the year, your take-home pay, any other income, and your kids' names.
2. Budget Plan: every monthly expense, grouped, marked Need, Want or Save. Give every dollar a job until Left to Plan is $0.
3. Spending: log what you spend (and savings transfers). Pick the budget item; add a child's name if it was for one of the kids.
4. This Month: plan vs spent for every line. Year: every group, every month.
5. Kids: what each child costs, planned and actual.
6. Safety Net: with one paycheck, a safety net matters. See how many months your emergency fund covers and check your life insurance.
7. Goals: vacation, Christmas, college and more, with the date you'll get there.
Plan every dollar: bills, spending AND savings. When Left to Plan is $0, your money has a job.
A handy check: many families aim for about 50% needs, 30% wants, 20% savings.
With one income, aim for 6 months of Need spending (or more).
A common rule of thumb: 10x yearly income, plus your mortgage and debts. Ask a licensed advisor for your family.
Shows the month you pick on Setup (blank = this month).
Clear the white cells on Budget Plan, Spending, Safety Net and Goals, then update Setup.
Tinted cells: these calculate for you.
Green: on track, or money left.
Red: over plan, or a gap to fix.
Thank you for your purchase! Here's to a calm, well-planned home.
